class.name: INI
class.brief_description: Reads and writes INI text as dictionaries, and any [Resource] as INI.

method.name: deserialize
method.description: Creates a [Resource] from INI [param text] written by [method serialize]. The class comes from the key [code]$type[/code] of the section [code][root][/code], or from [param type_hint]. Returns [code]null[/code] and prints an error if the text can't be read. The same as [code]ResourceTextSerializer.deserialize(text, ResourceTextSerializer.FORMAT_INI, type_hint, options)[/code].

method.name: get_data
method.description: Returns the sections read by the last successful call to [method parse], or an empty [Dictionary].

method.name: get_error_line
method.description: Returns the 1-based line of the error of the last call to [method parse], or [code]0[/code] if it succeeded.

method.name: get_error_message
method.description: Returns the error message of the last call to [method parse], or an empty [String] if it succeeded. The message starts with the position, for example [code]Line 2: ...[/code].

method.name: parse
method.description: Parses the INI [param text]. Returns [constant OK] and stores the sections for [method get_data], or [constant ERR_PARSE_ERROR] and stores the error for [method get_error_line] and [method get_error_message]. Errors are a section header without [code]][/code] and a line that is neither a comment, a header nor [code]key=value[/code].

method.name: parse_string
method.description: Parses the INI [param text] and returns its sections. Returns an empty [Dictionary] and prints the error if the text can't be read. Use [method parse] for the error details.

method.name: serialize
method.description: Returns [param resource] as INI text: one section per resource ([code][root][/code], [code][root/main][/code], [code][root/entries/0][/code]) with one key per stored property, and the type marker [code]$type[/code]. [code]null[/code] [param options] uses the project settings [code]filesystem/resources/text_formats/*[/code]. Returns an empty [String] and prints an error if the resource can't be written. The same as [code]ResourceTextSerializer.serialize(resource, ResourceTextSerializer.FORMAT_INI, options)[/code].

method.name: stringify
method.description: Writes the sections in [param data] as INI text. Every value of [param data] must be a [Dictionary] of keys; the section [code]""[/code] is written first, without a header. [param options] sets the value syntax ([member SerializerOptions.ini_plain_values]) and the order of sections and keys ([member SerializerOptions.sort_keys]); [code]null[/code] uses the project settings. Returns an empty [String] and prints an error if a section is not a [Dictionary], a section name contains [code]][/code] or a line break, or a key is empty.
